No periodic report forms confirmed. One weak candidate (C-RW-04).

coverage.found: Coffee EUDR/traceability: nothing new beyond K03, K09. Warehouse receipt law 58/2017 gives Capital Markets Authority licensing power; implementation status unclear; operators few (EAX dominant). No MINICOM/RAB miller or grain trader licensing rules surfaced. Weak candidate C-RW-07 (unverified).

coverage.category: 23. Co-operatives, credit unions and savings groups
coverage.found: Cooperative Law 057/2024; Umurenge SACCOs being consolidated into district D-SACCOs under BNR/Law 072/2021 (2026 job postings); RCA oversees audits of non-financial co-ops and keeps procedure manual (Nov 2022). No 2025 annual return deadlines found. Consolidation means fewer, larger buyers, and a state automation effort exists. Weak candidate C-RW-10.

coverage.category: 24. Private clinics, labs and other health providers that bill insurers or state schemes
coverage.found: Nothing new beyond K01, K07, K08, K13. Not re-searched.

coverage.category: 25. Pharmacies, medicine importers, and users of controlled chemicals or precursors
coverage.found: Rwanda FDA import authorisation rules (DD/DIEC/TRG/001 v4; guideline DIS/GDL/047) and published lists of licensed importers (cosmetics/household chemicals list May 2026 with expiry dates). Nothing on controlled-drug or precursor registers surfaced; pharmacy ongoing obligations not confirmed. Pharmacies remain K01 phase 2. No new candidate; narcotics-register angle unchecked.

coverage.category: 26. Security, cleaning and manpower agencies, and the firms that hire their workers
coverage.found: Strong lead. Private security licensed by RNP (Law 16bis/2020; vetting committee; 3-month guard training; recruit identity checks before training). MIFOTRA+RNP joint inspection 2024: ~20.8% of ~30,000 guards lacked written contracts, plus unpaid overtime, missing RSSB contributions. Aug 2025 meeting: written contracts, bank-paid salaries, RSSB, medical insurance, working-hour limits, vetted guards, penalties warned. About 15 licensed companies and 75+ security cooperatives. C-RW-01. Cleaning and manpower agencies not searched.

coverage.category: 27. Construction, mining and quarry contractors and suppliers: site registers, accreditation, local-content reports
coverage.found: Mining and Quarry Law 072/2024 (26 Jun 2024); RMB licences incl. industrial, commercial small-scale and non-commercial quarries; district/sector authorities issue small and non-commercial quarry licences; exploration holders report to RMB every 6 months; REMA inspects. No local-content reporting found. Construction contractor registers/permits not searched. Weak candidate C-RW-06 (unverified).

coverage.category: 28. Notaries, land agents, real estate brokers and other professionals with periodic or anti-money-laundering reports
coverage.found: NLA draft framework (July 2026 reporting) to license/certify real estate brokers and property managers, with digital property coding and consumer protection; consultations targeted for completion by September 2026, effective date unknown. FIC Law 045/2021 amended Jan 2025 raising DNFBP obligations; whether brokers/notaries are named DNFBPs not confirmed. Notaries nothing found. C-RW-02.

coverage.category: 29. Hotels, guest houses and short-term rentals: guest registers, tourism levies
coverage.found: Tourism levy: Law 015/2025 (promulgated 27 May 2025), 3% of room rate, applies to hotels, motels, lodges, apartments and Airbnb; accommodation businesses register and remit monthly within 15 days after month-end; effective date reported as 1 July 2025 (final effect not confirmed). Guest register rule not found. C-RW-03 (related K12).

coverage.category: 30. Small exporters and importers facing traceability or certification rules: food, fish, timber, forest-risk commodities
coverage.found: NAEB horticulture export licence (free, annual, farm inspection per community guide) and phytosanitary certificate via RALIS/eRALIS portal (state tool); coffee EUDR is K03. Plastic-packaged import levy 0.2% of customs value (Law 010/2025, from 1 Jul 2025) is collected at the border by RRA with no separate filing found. No fish or timber rules found. Candidates C-RW-08, C-RW-09 weak.

coverage.category: 31. Mineral traders and processors (3T traceability, Law 072/2024)
coverage.found: RMB field officers run tagging/traceability with ITSCI; ITSCI not mandatory for all exports; no small-trader filing duties confirmed. Looks state-run; nothing promising. C-RW-06 covers mining and quarry. Search count limited.

coverage.category: 32. Data controllers and processors (NCSA registration, Law 058/2021)
coverage.found: Registration with NCSA mandatory (art. 29); transition deadline passed 15 Oct 2023; late registration still allowed; fines RWF 2-5M or 1% of revenue. Buyer group is generic across all sectors; clinics, schools and SACCOs are the quiet subset. C-RW-05, weak.

coverage.category: 33. Commercial vehicle roadworthiness inspection (RNP)
coverage.found: RNP inspects commercial vehicles every 6 months and private cars yearly at RNP centres (Remera, Gishushu, Ndera) with Irembo booking; fine RWF 25,000 under Presidential Decree 85/01; a draft traffic law (Sept 2025) would add vehicle immobilisation. Belongs to group A category 18; state-run booking via Irembo limits the gap. C-RW-11, weak.

coverage.category: 34. Plastic-packaged import levy (Law 010/2025)
coverage.found: 0.2% of customs value, collected at border via RRA, from 1 Jul 2025; no importer-side filing seen. Folded into C-RW-09.

coverage.category: 35. Early childhood development centres and private nurseries
coverage.found: ECD under Ministry of Gender and Family Promotion; centres accredited by districts or RDB; harmonised ECD standards in development (Jan 2026 conference). No licensing register or periodic filing found. Nothing new; group A category 20 overlap.

coverage.category: 36. Warehouse receipt operators (Law 58/2017, Capital Markets Authority)
coverage.found: CMA licenses warehouse receipt operators; implementation status unconfirmed; EAX operates first system since 2014. Few operators, so buyer pool is small. Folded into C-RW-07.
